headline: A claim scenario exists in which this coverage pays.
plain_english_why: Endorsement 7's condition — timely notice under Section 9 — is independent of what Exclusion 4(f) excludes. A claim can be excluded for a security-standards failure and still satisfy the notice condition, so there are real claim scenarios in which the carveback gives coverage back. The endorsement does the work it advertises.
scenario: Example: a ransomware event first discovered in March, where a Schedule B control had lapsed — excluded under 4(f) — but the Insured gave timely notice under Section 9. Endorsement 7 restores coverage and the claim pays.
